newsitem.title: USA: Marquette, Dade Intl in marketing effort.
newsitem.headline: Marquette, Dade Intl in marketing effort.

text.p: Marquette Medical Systems Inc said it and Dade International agreed to work together to help hospitals adopt a proven model for improving diagnosis and treatment of patients with chest pain.

The two companies both provide high-technology tools used in diagnosing heart attacks. Dade supplies systems that test the blood for specific proteins, or biomarkers, that indicate heart damage. Marquette supplies 12-lead ECG monitoring equipment.
The two companies' joint efforts are expected to include educational symposia on topics such as the clinical management of chest pain, continuous 12-lead ECG monitoring and serum cardiac biomarkers.
